aiCoachWelcome.title:
Meet Your
AI Fitness Coach.
aiCoachWelcome.subtitle: Stop copy-pasting workouts. Your coach knows your history, your progress, and what you need today.

aiCoachSetup.questionTime:
At what time do you usually
do your activity?
aiCoachSetup.questionDuration:
How much time do you usually
spend on your activity?
aiCoachSetup.durationCaption: I usually do activity for {{minutes}} minutes
aiCoachSetup.intensityExplainer: This controls how hard the AI pushes your training stimulus — not the % of max effort you'll train at. Higher intensity means more volume, density, and progressive overload pressure across your workouts.
aiCoachSetup.morningSub: I usually exercise in the morning
aiCoachSetup.afternoonSub: I do activity in the afternoon
aiCoachSetup.eveningSub: I do activities in the evening
aiCoachSetup.questionExperience: How much lifting experience do you have?
aiCoachSetup.experienceHint: This just helps us start you at the right place — you can change paths later.
aiCoachSetup.expBeginnerSub: A few months in, still learning the ropes
aiCoachSetup.expIntermediateSub: Training consistently, I know the lifts
aiCoachSetup.questionMode: How do you want to set up?
aiCoachSetup.easyModeSub: A few quick questions and you're training. We build a general program and learn the rest as you go.
aiCoachSetup.advancedModeSub: Full questionnaire — your maxes, weak points, periodization and nutrition. Best if you know your numbers.

aiCoachExtendedSetup.savedMsg: Your AI coach profile has been updated.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.notSureYet: ✓ Not sure yet — will figure out with data
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionHistorySubtitle: A beginner and an advanced lifter get opposite results from the same program.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionMaxesSubtitle: Estimated 1RMs. Be honest — programming calibrates from these.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionTechnicalSubtitle: Strength is not just muscles. Weak points determine the program.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionRecoverySubtitle: Most people overestimate work capacity. This determines recoverable volume, not motivation.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionConstraintsSubtitle: The optimal program you cannot execute is garbage.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionResponseSubtitle: This separates individualized programming from spreadsheet cosplay.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionNutritionSubtitle: Programming volume during a hard cut should not resemble surplus programming.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionPsychologySubtitle: A technically perfect program fails if compliance collapses.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.sectionTrackingSubtitle: Programming quality is limited by feedback quality.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionTrainingFocusSubtitle: This shapes exercise selection — are we packing muscle or moving heavy iron?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionSpecificGoal: State your goal precisely and numerically
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionSpecificGoalPlaceholder: e.g. 200kg squat within 6 months, stay under 93kg, bench +20kg
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionCompDateSubtitle: Set a target date and M-7EO will size your training blocks to peak you for it. Leave as None if you're not prepping for one.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionExperienceLevelSubtitle: This sets how fast you progress — true novices add weight every session; everyone else progresses week to week.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionHistoricalWorkoutDataSubtitle: Programs, logs, spreadsheet exports — anything. The more the AI knows about your history, the better it programs for you.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionHistoricalWorkoutDataPlaceholder:
e.g. Week 1: Squat 5×5 @ 120kg, Bench 4×8 @ 80kg...

Or paste a whole mesocycle, old coach notes, anything you have.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionOtherSportsSubtitle: Even recreational — 1–2x/week of boxing or basketball drains recovery. M-7EO uses this to avoid programming you into the ground.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionOtherSportsFrequency: How often do you do these sports?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionInjuryHistoryPlaceholder: e.g. Left knee meniscus 2022, lower back flare-ups
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionTrainingDaysSubtitle: AI uses this for muscle group rotation and recovery planning.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionMinPlateSubtitle: The lightest plate available in your gym (per side). We'll never add weight in smaller jumps than your bar can actually load.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionSquatFrequencySubtitle: How many times per week do you want to squat?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionBenchFrequencySubtitle: How many times per week do you want to bench?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionDeadliftFrequencySubtitle: How many times per week do you want to deadlift?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionResponseType: What training stimulus drives your gains?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionResponseTypeSubtitle: Different from what you've tried — what actually moves the needle for you.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionPainfulExercisesPlaceholder: e.g. Leg press hurts left knee, no good mornings
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionPreferredExercises: Exercises you want in your program
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionPreferredExercisesPlaceholder: e.g. Romanian deadlift, face pulls, pause bench
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionNutritionTracking: Connect M-7EO to your food tracker?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionNutritionTrackingSubtitle: When enabled, M-7EO reads your logged meals and warns you when nutrition is hurting your training — e.g. severe calorie deficit before a heavy session. ⚠️ This only works if you log consistently. If you track food in another app or skip logging often, keep it off.
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionMissedLiftResponse: When you miss a lift, you…
aiCoachExtendedSetup.optionSpirals: Get in your head about it
aiCoachExtendedSetup.questionOvershootsEffort: Do you regularly exceed prescribed effort?
aiCoachExtendedSetup.expressStartSub: Just a couple of things and we'll build your first program. We'll learn the rest as you train.

formCheck.title: Form Check
formCheck.aiHint: Upload a short video (a rep or two) and AI reviews the whole movement — or add 1–3 photos for a static check.
formCheck.exercisePlaceholder: e.g. Back Squat, Deadlift, Bench Press
formCheck.cameraTip_squat: Film from the side at hip height (~45° in front works too). Keep your whole body in frame so the AI can judge depth, knee tracking, and bar path.
formCheck.cameraTip_bench: Film from the side at bench height. Capture the full bar path, your arch, and elbow position so the AI can score the touch point and lockout.
formCheck.cameraTip_deadlift: Film from the side at hip height with your full body in frame. The AI needs to see your hips, bar path, and back angle from setup to lockout.
formCheck.notesPlaceholder: Any specific concerns? e.g. lower back rounding, left knee caving
formCheck.analyzingVideo: Sampling frames and analyzing your rep… this takes ~15–20 seconds
formCheck.analyzingPhoto: Analyzing your form with AI… this takes ~10 seconds
formCheck.coachHint: Submit a video or photos and our IronLab coaches will give you personalised feedback.
formCheck.coachNotesPlaceholder: What do you want the coach to focus on?
formCheck.nothingToAnalyzeMsg: Add a short video or 1–3 photos of your form.
formCheck.exerciseRequiredMsg: Tell us what exercise you are performing.
formCheck.noMediaMsg: Add a video or photo first.
formCheck.submitSuccessMsg: Our team will review your form and respond shortly.
formCheck.communityHint: Share a clip or photos of your lift with the IronLab community and get technique feedback from other lifters. Everyone can comment.
formCheck.communityNotesPlaceholder: What do you want feedback on? e.g. is my depth okay?
formCheck.communityNote: Your post appears in the community feed where members can comment with tips.
